title: OpenModelDB tagged model browser and Stability Matrix style staged download manager
rationale: OpenModelDB tags and resource metadata materially improve model selection by exposing intended use, platform, architecture, format and scale.
The Stability Matrix interaction pattern is appropriate for catalog browsing, resource selection and visible download progress without importing its authority model.
FA3 must preserve its existing Model Registry and Model Artifact Security authorities, therefore downloads terminate in verified staging rather than runtime model directories.
OpenModelDB receives a highlighted source button adjacent to Hugging Face on the Models & Providers surface.
